selena_security: Planning a retest slot for Sat 2026-05-02 10:00-13:00 PT. Need RBAC snapshot, KMS decrypt via proxy (no key access), and a tamper-evident audit export. Calling owners and blockers.

rashid_infra: I have a storage migration on 5/2 morning. I can shift it but need firm freeze window.

selena_security: Let's request a freeze of 07:00-15:00 PT that day to be safe. Assessors need stable logs + no policy churn.

noelle_ops: OK. Two clarifying Qs: 1) which logs exactly (auth/app/infra/metrics)? 2) do assessors require actual plaintext decrypt for artifacts or can we provide signed attestations?

tyler_sre: They asked to re-run traces, so we must provide app logs, auth logs, runtime traces, and sampled Prom histograms for inference nodes. Export window: 09:40-13:10 PT (gives 20m pre/post buffer). Also capture cache hit/miss series.

ida_research: For KMS, assessors sometimes need decrypt to verify signed blobs. Preferred is a proxy that performs Decrypt on behalf of assessor and returns plaintext over TLS while logging the call. Proxy must not allow key policy changes or export key material.

selena_security: Proposed flow: create assessor-retest role assumed via our CI approval flow, issue short-lived STS creds (TTL=7200s), run kms-proxy service that accepts bearer tokens and enforces per-request ACLs, and write proxy audit records to the export bucket. Approve?

rashid_infra: Sounds good. Implementation notes: we'll create roles: role/kms-proxy-infra and role/assessor-retest. Proxy in a private subnet, egress to KMS endpoint via VPC endpoint. We'll add the proxy principal to KMS key policy for kms:Decrypt and kms:DescribeKey only. Also schedule a key rotation hold: disable automatic rotations from -7 to +7 days around the retest.

noelle_ops: Export plan: S3 bucket with Object Lock (Governance) 120d, SSE-KMS with the same audit key, manifest.json with SHA512 checksums, and CloudTrail export of KMS, STS:AssumeRole, S3 PutObject, and IAM Change events. We'll also include a signed manifest (GPG) and an integrity report.

tyler_sre: For traces: enable full APM sampling for the export window and push a prometheus snapshot to long-term TSDB. Please confirm we have TSDB retention quota — if not we'll sample only key namespaces.

ida_research: CLI examples for intake doc:```bash
# get temp creds via CI-approved flow
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-retest --role-session-name pen_retest --duration-seconds 7200
# call proxy for decrypt
curl -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal.redwood/api/decrypt \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEMP_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"ciphertext":"<base64>...","request_id":"<uuid>"}'
```Proxy must emit an audit line with request_id, key_id, caller_arn, and response_hash.

rashid_infra: Key policy change: allow arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-proxy-infra to kms:Decrypt and kms:DescribeKey. No direct ARN for assessor. Add kms:ViaService and aws:SourceVpc conditions.

noelle_ops: I'll prepare the export runbook. Checklist items I will add: 
- infra freeze 07:00-15:00 PT on 2026-05-02
- approval gate via security manager in CI for creating assessor role
- kms-proxy infra + key policy update
- S3 Object Lock Governance 120d + manifest + SHA512 + GPG sig
- CloudTrail filter + exported events + pre/post checksums
- APM full sampling + Prom snapshot to long-term TSDB

tyler_sre: Please do NOT disable MFA on any principal. Use CI approval to mint the assessor STS creds so we maintain MFA/logging.

selena_security: Agreed. Approval gate required. No permanent privilege changes.

noelle_ops: Who will hand over the data to assessors? We can provide a presigned S3 prefix URL with time-limited access and a separate endpoint for manifest download. The kms-proxy remains the only path for decrypt operations.

ida_research: Also recommend signing the final bundle with our internal GPG key and publishing the GPG public key fingerprint in the runbook so assessors can verify.

selena_security: Audit note: add a step to collect CloudWatch Logs export + S3 export and then run a signing step producing manifest.sig. Include checksums for each file and a vector of CloudTrail event IDs.

auditbot: Ticket PT-6001 opened: "retest 2026-05-02 06 - KMS proxy + RBAC snapshot + audit export" assigned to #eng-infra, #eng-ops, #eng-sre. Approval: security manager signoff required.

noelle_ops: Scheduling a dry-run Wed 2026-04-29 09:00 PT to exercise the proxy and export. RSVP here.

tyler_sre: I'll attend. Can someone confirm long-term TSDB capacity?

rashid_infra: I'll post capacity numbers in PT-6001 by EOD Fri; if low we'll limit namespaces.

selena_security: Action items: 
- @rashid_infra: create kms-proxy role, update key policy, and set key rotation hold window
- @noelle_ops: author export runbook, Object Lock bucket, CloudTrail filter, and presigned manifest flow
- @tyler_sre: enable APM sampling for window and prepare TSDB snapshot plan
- @ida_research: prepare GPG signing process, manifest format, and example CLI snippets
- @selena_security: coordinate assessor intake, CI approval flow, and signoff gate

noelle_ops: I'll attach the draft runbook to PT-6001 shortly.

selena_security: Thanks all. Reopen if blockers appear before dry-run.

auditbot: PT-6001 status: open -> in_progress (assigned).
